en.i1t: Six sessions, five active days — and the first logged tonnage in a week
en.i1: 6 sessions across 5 active days, 6h19 and ~3,098 active kcal. Three strength days (Thursday's squat, Saturday's trap-bar deadlift, Tuesday's hack squat), two Zagreb hikes totalling 11.9 km, and one 2.2 km pool set. Friday was the only full rest day. Saturday was the biggest single day at 817 active kcal — a 57-minute lift followed straight by a 52-minute hike. Tuesday's hack squat is the only session carrying logged tonnage: 12,506 kg over 21 sets and 168 reps.
en.i2t: Hack squat stepped up to 185 kg — intensity bought with volume
en.i2: Tuesday's top set was 185 kg × 6, held for three working sets, against 160 kg × 10 × 3 on Jul 21. Top-end load is up 25 kg (+16%) while the lift's own tonnage fell from 6,040 to 4,890 kg and total session volume from 13,480 to 12,506 kg. Per-set HR peaks ran 108 → 129 → 115 → 120 → 131 → 134 → 138 across the seven sets. The heavier session was the cheaper one cardiovascularly: the 185 kg sixes peaked at 131/134/138 where the 160 kg tens peaked at 137/145/147 — shorter sets, lower demand, more load on the machine.
en.i3t: Two of the three lifts are still Garmin-only
en.i3: Thursday's squat (57 min, avg HR 112, max 151, 474 kcal) and Saturday's trap-bar deadlift (57 min, avg HR 105, max 136, 411 kcal) never reached Hevy, so tonnage and per-set peaks are missing for both and their names come from the weekly plan rather than the log. Tuesday's hack squat is the first lift logged since Jul 21 — that logging gap is also why the lift chart held nothing between Jul 7 and this week. Both Jul 21 and Jul 28 have now been added, each flagged as an estimated set-peak read.
en.i4t: Recovery: HRV turning up, sleep turning short
en.i4: This morning HRV recovered to 42 (+5 on yesterday's 37) and average stress fell to 20, the calmest of the seven days — but sleep came in at 5h27, 48 minutes under the 6h 15m average, with deep sleep down to 55 minutes from 123. RHR is unchanged at 55, still the window high. Score 72. Sunday evening still has no sleep record, so the sleep chart runs Tue 21 → Tue 28 with Sun 26 skipped.
en.rec: Wednesday's swim intervals should go ahead, and this time they should actually happen — the session has been traded for a hike two weeks running, and with only Monday's 2.2 km in the window pool volume is at half the plan. It also suits this morning: aerobic, low joint cost, and it asks nothing of legs that took 185 kg × 6 for three sets yesterday. Swim Monday's template — 10×100 / 10×50 — rather than extending it, because sleep is the constraint right now, not fitness: two nights running under 6h30 and 48 minutes below average this morning. Next: swim intervals today, squat Thursday, rest Friday, trap-bar deadlift Saturday. Hold Thursday's squat at its last load — the hack squat jump was this week's new stimulus, and one new stimulus per week is enough.

hr.i1t: Šest treninga, pet aktivnih dana — i prva zabilježena tonaža u tjedan dana
hr.i1: 6 treninga kroz 5 aktivnih dana, 6h19 i ~3.098 aktivnih kcal. Tri dana snage (četvrtkov čučanj, subotnje trap-bar mrtvo dizanje, utorkov hack squat), dva zagrebačka uspona ukupno 11,9 km i jedan bazenski set od 2,2 km. Petak je bio jedini potpuni dan odmora. Subota je bila najveći pojedinačni dan s 817 aktivnih kcal — trening snage od 57 minuta pa odmah uspon od 52 minute. Utorkov hack squat jedini je trening sa zabilježenom tonažom: 12.506 kg kroz 21 seriju i 168 ponavljanja.
hr.i2t: Hack squat skočio na 185 kg — intenzitet plaćen volumenom
hr.i2: Utorkova najteža serija bila je 185 kg × 6, zadržana kroz tri radne serije, naspram 160 kg × 10 × 3 od 21.7. Vršni teret veći je za 25 kg (+16%), dok je tonaža same vježbe pala sa 6.040 na 4.890 kg, a ukupni volumen treninga sa 13.480 na 12.506 kg. Vrhovi pulsa po seriji išli su 108 → 129 → 115 → 120 → 131 → 134 → 138 kroz sedam serija. Teži je trening bio jeftiniji za srce: šestice sa 185 kg vrhovile su na 131/134/138, dok su desetke sa 160 kg išle na 137/145/147 — kraće serije, manji zahtjev, više tereta na spravi.
hr.i3t: Dva od tri treninga snage i dalje su samo na Garminu
hr.i3: Četvrtkov čučanj (57 min, prosj. puls 112, maks 151, 474 kcal) i subotnje trap-bar mrtvo dizanje (57 min, prosj. puls 105, maks 136, 411 kcal) nikad nisu stigli u Hevy, pa im nedostaju tonaža i vrhovi pulsa po seriji, a nazivi dolaze iz tjednog plana, ne iz zapisa. Utorkov hack squat prvi je zabilježeni trening snage nakon 21.7. — ta je rupa u bilježenju i razlog zašto graf dizanja nije imao ništa između 7.7. i ovog tjedna. Sada su dodani i 21.7. i 28.7., oba označena kao procijenjeno očitanje vrhova serija.
hr.i4t: Oporavak: HRV se okreće gore, san se skraćuje
hr.i4: Jutros se HRV oporavio na 42 (+5 na jučerašnjih 37), a prosječni stres pao je na 20, najmirnije u sedam dana — ali san je stao na 5h27, 48 minuta ispod prosjeka od 6h 15m, uz duboki san smanjen na 55 minuta sa 123. RHR je nepromijenjen na 55, i dalje najviši u prozoru. Ocjena 72. Nedjelja navečer i dalje nema zapisa sna, pa graf sna ide od Uto 21 do Uto 28, uz preskočen Ned 26.
hr.rec: Srijedini bazenski intervali trebaju se odraditi — i ovaj put stvarno. Trening se već dva tjedna zaredom mijenja za planinarenje, a uz samo ponedjeljkovih 2,2 km u prozoru bazenski volumen je na pola plana. Odgovara i ovom jutru: aerobno, malo opterećenja za zglobove, i ne traži ništa od nogu koje su jučer podnijele 185 kg × 6 kroz tri serije. Odradi ponedjeljkov predložak — 10×100 / 10×50 — bez produljivanja, jer je san trenutačno ograničenje, a ne forma: dvije noći zaredom ispod 6h30 i 48 minuta ispod prosjeka jutros. Sljedeće: bazenski intervali danas, čučanj u četvrtak, odmor u petak, trap-bar mrtvo dizanje u subotu. Četvrtkov čučanj zadrži na zadnjem teretu — skok na hack squatu bio je ovotjedni novi podražaj, a jedan novi podražaj tjedno je dovoljan.
